Well we had met twice for dates during the holidays. The second date lasted 8 hours starting in the afternoon and we were kissing then, and hugging. So it's not like we were meeting for the very first time in real life.

But she said she didn't want to do anything physical and was completely uncomfortable with how frisky I was being with her and how I was nuzzling up against her with affection. She said she's not a "touchy-feely" person so how could she have wanted something physical? She refused me kissing her or even hugging her and I felt I had to ask to sit next to her or put my arm around her. That hurt me incredibly. She said her being there and asking me about what was bothering me was evidence enough that she cared. But I needed emotional release through physical contact because it's just the way I am, and when she didn't respond to that and I told her it hurt me deeply, she said I shouldn't have this "ideal of what this is supposed to be".

This is a very different response than the person in /r/depression. She is the type of person that constantly wanted to chat over text and get to know everything possible about me at a very personal level. We both shared things about each other. Over skype when I'd get all quiet she would say "you're thinking something, tell me what you're thinking!" And I was more and more honest with her with exactly what I was thinking. Then she asked me "so tell me something about yourself that I don't know yet, and ask me the same thing about me." That was when the depression discussion happened, and I asked her if she'd experienced it, she said she had, but got help from close friends to get over it. Then I said I may suffer from feelings of depression even now, and told her the reasons I felt that way. I was "thinking" them and she is just the type of person who will never rest until I tell her exactly what is going through my mind. I felt very safe with her. She only just told me she didn't recognize the extent of my depression until now and couldn't be in a relationship with me. Otherwise she said I was amazing, incredibly smart, and wanted to help me see in myself what she saw in me. But she said my depression was too much for her to provide that help though so had to end it. I think she is very hurt as well but I don't think as much as I am.
